Can you reissue the invite to olivia@helixcomp.com (primary contact) or tell us the best workaround to claim the profile without exposing payables? We need PO visibility for the Dec 20 shipment.

Subject: Steps to claim supplier profile (temporary manual-claim)

Hi Olivia / Marcus,

Thanks for flagging this — sorry for the friction. We made a CRM update to set olivia@helixcomp.com as the primary onboarding contact. Below are two things to try; please work through them in order and reply here with the result.

Option A — Resend invite (preferred):
1) I will ask Ops to resend the portal invite to olivia@helixcomp.com.
2) Click the link in the email and follow the Coupa acceptance flow.
3) If the page shows 'this account was claimed by another email' let us know immediately.

Option B — Manual-claim fallback (if the resend doesn't work):
1) Open the acceptance link and click 'I have a claim code' (or similar).
2) Paste the claim code from the attached file (claim-code.txt).
3) If you get a 'session token missing' error, try opening the acceptance link in an incognito/private window and paste the code there. Sometimes existing cookies cause Coupa to drop the token.

If neither works we will escalate to Coupa support and request a server-side remap of the claim to olivia@helixcomp.com.

Attachment: claim-code.txt (text, contains single-use 8-character code)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@helixcomp.com>

Marissa / Laura — thanks, we followed Option B in incognito and the claim code accepted. We can now see the pending PO (PO-48291) in the portal.

One quick ask: can you confirm which internal contact receives PO notifications? Right now our payables team still gets invoice notifications and we'd prefer only order/PO notices go to operations@helixcomp.com.
